patch.value: Outcome milestone: federated agent fabric — bounded context and conflict-safe coordination across workspaces and thousands of agents

Prove that pm can coordinate thousands of agents across many repositories and decades of work without a central authority becoming a correctness or availability requirement. This milestone composes the existing scale federation allocation identity merge-safety and fleet-context lineages into one measurable organizational outcome.

A reference deployment coordinates at least one thousand concurrent agents across at least one hundred federated workspaces with no lost acknowledged mutation; Cross-workspace context dependency resolution and work allocation remain bounded by declared latency memory and token budgets at million-item aggregate scale; Branch and workspace convergence is property-tested across mixed client versions failure injection partitions retries and independent merge orderings; Every conflict dropped value and policy decision has a machine-readable receipt and an immutable evidence path; The federation has no mandatory central service for correctness and documents explicit consistency availability and privacy tradeoffs
Scale correct agent collaboration from one repository to a federated organizational context fabric
Organizations can coordinate large heterogeneous agent fleets without losing local ownership merge safety or bounded context
Unifies workspace federation fleet allocation context amortization cross-version compatibility and convergence guarantees
A proven federated agent fabric with measurable correctness performance and recovery properties
Federation allocation and thousand-agent work are individually tracked but the outcome ladder has no gate that composes them after proven single-workspace scale
